wind.windToFlutter_note: recommended strength->wind_flutter_loop weight (piecewise linear; ~38% already at 0.15 so hem/apron edge/bangs visibly flutter at the door exit). Same as the driver default; wind clips not authored yet.
wind.ribbonwind_note: wind_flutter_loop (renamed from wind_sway_loop) per-channel amplitude vs original: ribbon x0.4, skirt.front.mid x1.0, skirt.front.low.mid x1.0, other 8 skirt bones x0. Walking-only per Grok Bot (sit/indoor 0 in code). apron*/hair* in mask match no channels in this clip.

driver_contract: GGbot work/GGbot-walk afb5d7b docs/walk-driver.md; deploy path bundles/region_island/character/anim_meta.json

compression.clips: keys reduced per channel (greedy; slerp / lerp error <= 0.03 deg hips+legs, 0.20 deg spine/chest/neck, 0.20 deg head/arms/hands, 0.30 deg skirt, root/hips translation 0.1 mm), rest translations / scales omitted, float32, LINEAR; source mocap low-passed (gauss sigma 4 frames at 120 fps) before retargeting. walk_loop / walk_start / walk_stop_bodyL / walk_stop_bodyR: each hand is turned about the finger axis so the face a side camera sees points at the skirt and a little down (the back of the hand turns outward). The forearm is not rolled past the elbow, and upper_arm is untouched. Her left shoe (bone .R) is planted flat and forward on its existing contact path, and pulled in when that plant is wider than 50 mm. Swing yaw is clamped. Her right shoe keeps its heel-to-toe roll. Turns, idle, door, wind, bow, and the sit clips are unchanged. door_reach right arm (upper_arm.L, forearm.L, hand.L): palm aimed at the closed door with the same two-bone IK, key tolerance 0.20 deg on those three curves

events_note: events: name foot:L|foot:R, bone foot.L|foot.R, body = her actual side (bone .L = her right); type heel_strike | settle (small settling step: softer sound)
